tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search ~459,000 active US hospital/healthcare jobs (staff and permanent roles). Returns up to 20 matches with title, employer, city and state, the pay when the posting lists it, the state license a licensed role needs, and a link to the job page. Jobs with verified-working apply links rank first.

tools.name: search_travel_contracts
tools.description: Search ~110,000 active US travel nursing / allied health contracts with weekly pay. Highest-paying first. Links go to the contract page on Waypoint, which names the staffing agency and links to its posting.

tools.name: get_hospital_wages
tools.description: Hourly pay ranges (nursing, allied health, imaging, NP/PA) for a US hospital system covering 433 US hospital systems (3,978 hospitals), last updated November 2026. Search by system name.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_travel_contracts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search ~121,000 active US travel nursing / allied health contracts with weekly pay. Highest-paying first. Links go to the contract page on Waypoint, which names the staffing agency and links to its posting." → after: "Search ~110,000 active US travel nursing / allied health contracts with weekly pay. Highest-paying first. Links go to the contract page on Waypoint, which names the staffing agency and links to its posting."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
